evidence: The Heaphy Track is not a circuit track.
You can start the track either from
Brown Hut in Golden Bay – 156 km from Nelson – at the end of Aorere Valley Rd, or
The track follows the riverbank for 400 m to Kohaihai carpark where there is a shelter and phone.

doubts: The page says the track can be started either from Brown Hut or from Kohaihai. This is one way, recorded from Brown Hut as the page presents it (east to west), with Kohaihai as an access point; walking it the other way is not a separate way. Kohaihai (F1, the road end where the track meets Kohaihai Rd) is also the main way's end, so it is both the access point and the end. Brown Campsite is listed at the start hut and is not in the via list. Flanagans Corner is a viewpoint reached by a short track 30 min before Perry Saddle Hut, but the page also calls 915 m 'the highest point on the track', so I put it in via with a null ref; this may be a side trip rather than a point the main way passes. The via list includes campsites on the way (Aorere Shelter, Perry Saddle, Gouland Downs, Saxon, James Mackay, Heaphy, Katipo Creek, Scotts Beach and Kohaihai). The Lewis Shelter is an emergency shelter with no overnight stays, so it is a via and not a hut. Crayfish Stream is recorded as a ford because the text says to take care crossing it and does not mention a bridge; this is a judgement. The distance comes from DOC's summary (78.4 km one way) and the time is DOC's (4-6 days). The air service exit is recorded with from null because the page does not say where the return flight leaves.
